title: PED resourcepack
description: Extension for my datapack. Renames for item to make better sense because of the new loot tables, retextures to fit "my" sense of what fits into the base game.
body:
# About:
This resourcepack was made for my [datapack](https://modrinth.com/project/XaAk8Zyr) (and my [modpack](https://modrinth.com/project/FpW2JKI1)).
With this resourcepack I want item names to make more sence in the changed loot tables and crafting recepies. Later, it will also include new textures for newer mobs/blocks.

### Example item renaming:
- Rabbit hide is droped by bats in my datapack so it's renamed to "leather piece".
### Example mobs:
- Phantom
- Strider
- Frog
- Sniffer

Currently, the pack supports English and Hungarian. More languages will be added if requested.
